name: Demon Appearance
overview: Scripture reveals that demons and Satan operate as powerful spiritual beings opposing God's purposes, described as rulers of darkness and deceivers of the world (Ephesians 6:12; Revelation 12:9). While angels may appear as strangers to humans (Hebrews 13:2), the devil and his demons are depicted as malevolent forces engaged in spiritual warfare, evident in the archangel Michael's respectful rebuke of the devil (Jude 1:9). The symbolic beast with blasphemous names rising from the sea (Revelation 13:1) further illustrates the demonic realm's opposition to God, emphasizing the unseen yet real spiritual conflict that believers face.
